findings.text: records() merges each key first-writer-wins, so the stored_coefficients mapping of tcv-iter-long/measurement.json is dropped once mastu-titan2/measurement.json has set stored_coefficients, and the landed fragment prints coefficients=[] for TCV and ITER instead of the coefficient vector done_when (3) requires.

the displaced step is DIFFERENCE_STEP * max(abs(raw[0]), 1.0) = 1e-4 on a coefficient stored as 0.0, and tests/test_magnetics_fit_efit_comparison.py defines no displacement at all, so the arm is not the displaced coefficients the comparison's fit asked for and its NoQualifiedAxisError does not reproduce the banked active-set refusal at 1.2e-4.

a non-finite terminal residual prints as the literal 'nonfinite' and no last finite residual is carried, although mastu-titan2/comparison/mastu-stored-default-generating-failure.json records finite_residual_entries: 8, so the record holds no operand a reader could compare against the banked 4.9e-10.

_write and _json_safe re-implement the _write that tests/test_magnetics_fit_efit_comparison.py:107 already owns — a module this script imports four helpers from — and collapse the finite/nan/unavailable distinction its _residual_fields keeps, so a refused arm stores residual: null, which reads the same as an arm that never produced a residual.
the raw sbatch --wrap carries no --job-name, against the binding rule that a raw --wrap submission names the work beside its explicit --mem and core sizing.
the recorded tests: line carries the unsubstituted {node_test_files} placeholder instead of a literal command, so the gate receipt promotion fills from it cannot be re-run.
